definition: score = area(blocker footprint ∩ nominal drop footprint) / area(cube footprint); drop footprint = held-cube footprint centred on the destination centre

valid_rest_rule.BLOCK_BUFFER: blocker on the pad (|offset| <= half - cube = 0.060) or off the pad (|offset| >= half + cube = 0.100)
valid_rest_rule.BLOCK_CONTAINER: blocker footprint fully inside the opening (|offset| <= inner - cube = 0.010) or disjoint from the wall boxes
